links.label: Novel Materials Discovery Laboratory Database (NOMAD)
links.note: Legacy repository host redirects to NOMAD. Archive entries are not a unique-crystal census.

links.note: Includes publication and provenance services; individual MC3D/MC2D/EPC deposits have separate counts.

links.label: Super Conducting Material Database (SuperCon)
links.note: Retained the versioned MDR SuperCon record and historical GUI URL; current release size is unverified.

links.note: The supplied MOFDB route is branded MOFX DB and hosts overlapping framework/adsorption datasets.

links.label: International Center for Diffraction Data (ICDD)
links.note: Corrected scope: organic and inorganic diffraction data. Paid product/version counts remain explicit.

links.label: Materials Data Repository (NIST)
links.note: Repository platform; provider-level records/files do not create another independent crystal corpus.

links.label: Inorganic Materials Database (NMIS; NIMS AtomWork)

links.label: Knowledgebase of Interatomic Models (OpenKIM)
links.note: Potential models, verification tests and generated predictions are separate record types, not experimentally measured crystals.

links.label: Polymer Database (PoLyInfo)
links.note: DICE/MatNavi application and provider restrictions apply; chemical polymer structures do not imply periodic coordinates.

links.label: Polymer Property Predictor and Database (PPPDB)
links.note: Public polymer-property tables and prediction tools; atomic-coordinate payload and blanket data license unverified.

links.label: WebFF
links.note: Documentation is reachable; live data portal could not be confirmed. Parameters are not crystal records.

links.label: Configurable Data Curation System (CDCS)
links.note: Repeated CDCS bullet counted once. Original path redirects to the current NIST organizational path.

links.label: Polymer Properties Database
links.note: Endpoint currently serves a hosting-provider unavailability page. No formal service-termination claim is inferred.

links.label: SuperBand
links.note: 2,474 band-data entries remain separate from the larger reference CSV. Negative-label provenance needs care.

links.label: UCI Superconductivty Data legacy route
links.note: 21,263 composition-based rows are a SuperCon derivative; formula/descriptor files represent the same cohort.

links.label: NIST High Temperature Superconducting Materials Database / SRD 62
links.note: Historical WebHTS/SRD 62 corpus; content last updated 1996. Current count and redistribution rights remain qualified.

links.label: Superconductor Discovery in the Emerging Paradigm of Materials Informatics (ACS review)
links.note: Verified 2024 review; accessible author manuscript. CompSC current corrected release has 586 structures, not the older 587 count.

links.label: NIST 62: NIST/NRIM High Temperature Superconductors Database Version 2.0
links.note: The 2008 publication documents the same SRD 62/WebHTS family; it is not another experimental corpus.

links.label: Organic Superconductor Database conference abstract (ADS 2021APS..MARX61003G)
links.note: Official APS abstract describes Clark OSD (Ganter/Agosta, March 2021). It does not establish UCSD SRD counts or structures.

links.label: UCSD Superconducting Research Database (SRD)
links.note: Owning UCSD group documents the project. Live server errors left current counts, payload, licensing and test-status definitions unverified.

coverage_notes: The supplied list contains 26 resource bullets, including CDCS twice, plus 8 additional link mentions, including UCSD SRD twice. The inventory collapses exact URL duplicates to 32 entries; one canonical resource is used for CDCS.
Original HTTP/HTTPS schemes, historical hostnames and requested article routes are retained as source links. Their inclusion does not assert that each legacy endpoint remains functional.
The OQDM and NMIS labels are preserved with the correct OQMD and NIMS/AtomWork identities; historical user-supplied numerical descriptions are not substituted for verified release counts.
Polymers, force-field/model libraries, registries, curation software, review papers and dataset portals receive scope labels and do not increase the count of independent crystal datasets.
The supplied ADS bibcode resolves to the Clark University Organic Superconductor Database conference presentation; it is kept distinct from UCSD SRD.
